source.text:
This software is designed to generate decompression profiles based on various different theoretical decompression calculations. These decompression profiles should be taken to be experimental in nature and should not be used without an understanding of the inherent risk of Decompression Sickness. No decompression procedures of any sort can guarantee that DCS will NOT occur.
The only way to avoid risk of DCS is to NOT DIVE.
The authors and distributor of this software will not be held accountable for any injury caused by the use of a profile generated by this software.

Privacy notice: 
In order to register your copy of this software with GUE, this software will read your current IP address and computer hardware serial number in order to protect your license and prevent abuse. GUE will never forward or sell this information to third parties, or use it for any purpose not related to DecoPlanner licensing. If this is not acceptable to you, please click the "Abort" button below.
